# Accounts

Tempo.ts provides Viem-compatible [Local Accounts](https://viem.sh/docs/accounts/local) that support multiple signature schemes including **secp256k1**, **P256**, and **WebAuthn (passkeys)**, as well as **configurable** accounts.

These accounts are fully backwards compatible with Viem APIs, meaning you can use them any Viem Action that accepts an `account`.

:::code-group

```ts twoslash [example.ts]
// @twoslash-cache: {"v":1,"hash":"c1884eeb28b44a2741b46ff1a05eaa417a9b7098e3a8ef5c756b81d90c1e02e5","data":""}
import { Account, Client, WebAuthnP256 } from 'viem/tempo'

// Create a passkey account
const credential = await WebAuthnP256.createCredential({ label: 'Example' })
const account = Account.fromWebAuthnP256(credential)

const client = Client.create()

// Use with Viem APIs
const receipt = await client.transaction.sendSync({
  account,
  data: '0xcafebabe',
  to: '0xdeadbeefdeadbeefdeadbeefdeadbeefdeadbeef',
})
```

:::

## Account Types

| Type | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`fromSecp256k1`](/tempo/accounts/account.fromSecp256k1) | Create an account from a secp256k1 private key (standard Ethereum accounts) |
| [`fromWebAuthnP256`](/tempo/accounts/account.fromWebAuthnP256) | Create an account from a WebAuthn credential (passkeys) |
| [`fromWebCryptoP256`](/tempo/accounts/account.fromWebCryptoP256) | Create an account from a WebCrypto P256 key pair |
| [`fromP256`](/tempo/accounts/account.fromP256) | Create an account from a P256 private key |
| [`fromConfig`](/tempo/accounts/account.fromConfig) | Create a configurable account from local owners, addresses, or weighted owners |

See the [Configurable Accounts guides](/tempo/guides/configurable-accounts) for end-to-end
transaction, access key, fee sponsorship, nesting, and owner rotation workflows.
